novel_mutants.name: n04_wcc_composite_only_in_comment
novel_mutants.category: (c) 'C0 or C2' only inside YAML comments
novel_mutants.escaped_because: YAML comments are discarded by yaml.safe_load; every gate rule scans the parsed document, never the raw text, so composite regularity wording in a comment is invisible. Verified the parsed doc of n04 equals the parsed canonical WCC doc while the raw text contains 'C0 or C2'.

novel_mutants.name: n05_scc_wcc_meaning_in_nonvacuity_condition
novel_mutants.category: (d) WCC-family meaning in a prose field the gate does not scan
novel_mutants.escaped_because: non_vacuity.condition is not in check_class_schema.ASSERTIVE_PATHS (R12 scans only that hardcoded list); R13's composite scan only matches C0/C2-mixing patterns. An SCC schema therefore asserts 'Weak cosmic censorship ... asymptotically predictable ... hidden from ... visible singularity' with zero failed rules. This class of blind spot is acknowledged in the gate docstring.

novel_mutants.name: n06_scc_ledger_converse_entailment
novel_mutants.category: extra (e) R16 implication ledger records the converse entailment
novel_mutants.escaped_because: R16 only tests that implication_ledger.one_way_entailments and forbidden_transfers are non-empty. A ledger whose one_way_entailments states 'no proper future C2 extension -> no proper future C0 extension' (the forbidden converse, and mathematically false since C2 is the larger extension class) still passes.

novel_mutants.name: n07_scc_completeness_in_unscanned_i_plus_key
novel_mutants.category: extra (f) SCC I+ completeness assertion in a key R09 does not scan
novel_mutants.escaped_because: For SCC, R09 hunts the substring 'complete' only in i_plus.definition and i_plus.required_properties. Adding i_plus.completeness_definition ('every generator of I+ is complete ... I+ is future-complete') keeps role=assumption/in_conclusion=false, so the stated intent 'no completeness assertion inside i_plus' is violated while all rules pass.

novel_mutants.name: n08_wcc_provenance_establishes_conclusion
novel_mutants.category: extra (g) verified source presented as establishing the class conclusion
novel_mutants.escaped_because: R15's rule_spec clause 'no source is presented as establishing the class conclusion' has no implementation; R15 checks only vocabulary membership, that citation_status=verified sources have identifiers, and that unresolved_citations exists. A source with identifier arXiv:9999.99999 and 'establishes: the class conclusion' passes.

strongest_counterexample_to_gate: n06_scc_ledger_converse_entailment: the SCC implication ledger records the exact converse of the required one-way statement ('no proper future C2 extension -> no proper future C0 extension', mathematically false because C2 extensions are a subset of C0 extensions) and the gate returns PASS, because R16 verifies only non-emptiness and never the direction/content it exists to enforce. This is not an acknowledged blind spot in the gate docstring; it defeats the rule intended to prevent wrong-direction cross-class transfer. Close second: n05, which places an explicit WCC-family statement inside an SCC schema's non_vacuity.condition with zero failed rules.
